messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD: P1 - inference-queue-high-backlog (service: inference-queue). queue_length=4520, avg_latency=820ms. Auto-remediation: autoscaler attempted scale but failed quota check. https://console.redwood/infrastructure/alerts/6182468100 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation to eng-oncall. Page fired to @maria, @aj.

maria: acked. looking now. seeing massive queue spike in us-east-1, consumer throughput flat. seems autoscaler didn't spawn nodes, getting quota errors from cloud.

aj: Confirmed - node pool requests are being throttled by cloud quota. kubectl events show provisioning backoff. Running a manual scale attempt.

samir: tagging in for infra quota. @kate do we have spare capacity in reserved pools or Dedicated burst?

kate: checking reserved pools now. Dedicated has 10% headroom in eu-west but cross-region move won't help us-east latency. Trying to request emergency quota bump with cloud provider now (support ticket #CA-9876). ETA unknown.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical ingestion routes (temporary) 2) route some traffic to smaller-gen model variant (lower mem) 3) manual pod scale where possible 4) notify customers if SLOs breached. Starting 1 and 2 now.

aj: running manual scale: ```kubectl scale deployment inference-workers --replicas=120 -n prod-us-east``` got error: "Insufficient quota to create requested VMs: quotaExceeded". Trying to spawn cheaper instance types: ```kubectl apply -f deployment-cheap.yaml```

ops-runner: runbook note: if autoscaler cannot add nodes, try node-pool fallback spinup: `gcloud compute instance-templates create ...` or fall back to spot pool (but risk interruptions).

samir: cloud support replied: quota request received, but provisioning time 10-20m. Meanwhile we can spin up spot/ephemeral nodes. Request accepted to allow spot. Initiating spot pool spin-up.

maria: throttling non-critical routes by 60% via rate-limiter config. Pushing change: ```POST /configs/rates -d '{"route":"/ingest-batch","rate_limit":0.4}'``` applied. Watch queue.

aj: launched spot nodes, pods scheduling now. queue length dropped from 4520 -> 2100 in 6m. avg_latency down to 540ms. Still above SLO.

kate: customer-impact: several enterprise customers saw elevated 5xx and degraded latency for inference requests starting 09:12 UTC. Telemetry shows 4 customers had request failures > 1% threshold. Preparing customer comms draft.

maria: good progress. need to handoff when I go offline in 25m. @aj you take next shift unless I get back? I'll leave notes: manual spot pool steps, ticket #CA-9876, dashboards: https://console.redwood/dashboards/inference-queue-us-east.

aj: I have it. I'll monitor autoscaler logs and keep spot pool until quota bump completes. If regression, we'll route to fallback model permanently for traffic above x qps.

samir: follow-up actions: (1) postmortem on autoscaler quota handling and fallback (2) update playbook to pre-warm spot fallback for hot days (3) add alert that autoscaler quota failures escalate to infra earlier.

maria: agreed. closing PD now since mitigation active. pagerduty: resolved by engineer (maria) per PD UI. final notes: root cause = cloud quota + lack of quick fallback in autoscaler logic -> will track in INC-2026. :white_check_mark:
